related_core_source.adoption: Product remains pinned to the existing published Core beta81; no unpublished dependency pin or installed overlay is introduced.

findings: A terminal HTTP response previously only triggered history reconciliation; a cached active shared snapshot could overwrite that history again.
The shared observer had no application-level health recovery and depended on onclose even after a greeting timeout or socket error.
A throwing observer callback could also prevent cleanup from reaching close/reconnect.
Deferred catalog delegation could clear provider tool provenance inside Core, leaving an admitted child without a live card link.
changes: An exact terminal receipt retires only the matching active projection, allowing canonical tool results and final replies to replace it immediately.
Account/grant-scoped bounded receipts prevent late active frames from reopening completed requests.
Missing terminal state triggers a read-only reattachment after 500 ms.
Negotiated numbered health checks refresh authorized snapshots after 15 seconds and retire an unresponsive reader after a further 10 seconds; legacy gateways renew after 45 silent seconds.
Greeting timeout, socket failure and listener failure retire the reader independently of onclose; diagnostics contain no transcript or malformed-frame content.
Health refresh preserves observer-local ACL revision offsets and rechecks child access.

incident_evidence.read_only_production_audit: The identified turn persisted run.success, all 18 tool completions and its final reply; no server restart or incomplete vault write explained the stale UI.
incident_evidence.replay_boundary: Replay retains event order, tool IDs, lifecycle and message lengths; private arguments/results and message text are removed. It is not a packet capture.
incident_evidence.unresolved_historical_boundary: The original observer packet/error trace was not retained before the view reload. The exact initial network/transport interruption cannot be attributed retrospectively.

scenarios: Six parallel vault writes: four frozen running cards recover all canonical completions and the final reply, exactly one HTTP submission.
A silent observer recovers another participant's completed turn without any local terminal HTTP receipt.
A running delegated card opens its child immediately after the child link arrives; ongoing tool status and subsequent streamed text remain visible.
Agent switching, saved logins and drawer layout remain functional.

boundaries: Electron tests run real production renderer/main/preload against a deterministic local gateway in a separate temporary profile, not the installed production profile.
No user prompt was resent, production run cancelled, agent restarted, credentials changed or data/retention policy modified.
Core's deferred-dispatch provenance source fix is separately qualified upstream; adopting it requires a future published Core version.
No App/server release, installed-app update or production rollout is asserted by this source push.
